incident.finding: 1180 of 1182 truth-lock refusals were caused by the MAIN checkout being left on 324 non-main branch(es) — the periodic runner was OUT (it refused to start), not detecting threats
incident.likelyCause: provider sessions working in the main checkout on feature branches (branch names are provider work branches); the actor who switched branches is NOT recorded
incident.remedy: provider work only in isolated worktrees (the main checkout stays on main) — already the standing V15.5 rule

1_nativeDecisions.source: runtime/generated/mission-attempt-log.jsonl (one row per tick decision by odg-schedule-tick) + runtime/generated/scheduler-audit-chain.json (audit-log.verifyChain)
1_nativeDecisions.note: every row is a decision TAKEN BY ODG CODE, but ROWS ARE NOT DISTINCT DECISIONS: the periodic runner repeats the same no-op (e.g. the same ALREADY_PROVEN dedup) every tick, and truth-lock refusals mostly record a runner OUTAGE (main checkout off main), not threats. Read meaningfulDecisions + distinctDecisionKinds, not value. The per-row trigger is NOT recorded; the 15-min cadence share is the evidence of the periodic runner. Wave selection / write-set refusals / repair-stop reasons only count when they appear in this persistent log — worktree runs a provider launched are reported separately (providerInvokedDecisions).

unmeasuredItems.kind: wave selection + write-set enforcement in worktree runs (narrative evidence; per-decision count not machine-recorded)

1b_providerInvokedDecisions.note: decisions ODG code took inside runs a PROVIDER launched (wave selection, write-set enforcement, supervisor recovery refusals) — ODG decisions, NOT unattended autonomy; kept out of counter 1. Items without a machine-recorded count are listed, never summed as 0.

2_nativeExecutions.source: mission-attempt-log PASS/FAIL rows (missions the ODG runner admitted+dispatched) + mission-ledger entries whose actor-provenance resolved actor=ODG (odg-autonomy-maturity-report)
2_nativeExecutions.note: an UNATTRIBUTED ledger entry is NOT counted native (validated ≠ natively executed). The ledger actor=ODG entries come from runs of ODG's deterministic native executor (EXEC ODG_NATIVE_EXECUTION); the run itself may have been provider-invoked.

3_providerDelegated.source: git log of the measured ref (non-merge commits: any case-insensitive Co-authored-by naming an AI provider (Claude/Anthropic/OpenAI/Copilot/Gemini/…) or 'Generated with <AI tool>'; merged PRs from 'Merge pull request #N' merge commits, delegated iff any commit of merge^1..merge^2 carries the attribution)
3_providerDelegated.note: provider work is NEVER native. 'unattributed' commits are NOT native either — they lack ANY actor provenance (owner hand-commits or older sessions).
